value_dated_balance.title: Value dated balance
value_dated_balance.description: Value dated balance results from recalculating credit or debit interest based on the back value date. By default, it is initialized with the book balance value. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

available_balance.title: Available balance
available_balance.description: The balance that is available for transactions, including credit balance and credit limit.

uncleared_funds.title: Uncleared funds
uncleared_funds.description: The balance of funds that got posted on the account but haven't been cleared/confirmed.

earmarked_balance.title: Earmarked balance
earmarked_balance.description: The credit balance on hold and thus removed from the available balance, but kept in the book balance. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

credit_balance.title: Credit balance
credit_balance.description: The balance of credit transactions posted into the account.

debit_balance.title: Debit balance
debit_balance.description: The outstanding balance from debit transactions after all credit balance is used. (Values larger than zero imply usage of a credit limit).

overdraft_limit.title: Overdraft limit
overdraft_limit.description: The value for maximum amount approved for overdraft spending on the account.

balance_update_datetime.title: Balance update datetime
balance_update_datetime.description: The balance integrity update datetime in UTC 0. Format = `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssssssssZ`.

posting_date.title: Transaction posting balance date
posting_date.description:
The business date of the balance. In the balance-change event, the `business_date` refers to the current business cycle date, it's the valid date determined by `cycle_closing_time config`. Note that the date may not be the same as the current date.

the balance-history event is used to check the updated balances from previous dates for backdated transactions, the balance-change event reflects the current account balance.

business_date.title: Balance business date
business_date.description: The business date sent on the payment request. If not sent, it will be the same value as the posting_date.

external_account_id.title: External account identifier
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description:
The type of operation that changed the account balance.

It can assume the values: 

`CREDIT`: When the change occurred because a credit was made. 

`DEBIT`: When the change occurred because a debit was made. 

`LIMIT_INCREASE`: When the overdraft limit for the account was increased. 

`LIMIT_DECREASE`: When the overdraft limit for the account was decreased. 

`ACCOUNT_CREATION`: When the account was created.

currency_code.title: Represents a 3-letter alphabetic code, conforming to the ISO 4217 standard, which corresponds to the currency utilized in the account balance

future_dated_credits_balance.title: Future dated credits balance
future_dated_credits_balance.description: Balance for financial products that require a settlement on a future date after the posting date. The `book_balance` of the account is credited upon settlement. The value for `future_dated_credits_balance` increases when future-dated credits are posted using the Post payment endpoint and decreases when such payments are settled or canceled. It is always a positive value.

future_dated_debits_balance.title: Future dated debits balance
future_dated_debits_balance.description: Balance for financial products that require a settlement on a future date after the posting date. The `book_balance` of the account is debited upon settlement. The value for `future_dated_debits_balance` increases when future-dated debits are posted using the Post payment endpoint and decreases when such payments are settled or canceled. It is always a positive value.

uncleared_checks_balance.title: Uncleared checks balance
uncleared_checks_balance.description: Represents the total value of checks that have been posted but are not yet cleared. These funds are not considered available to the bank until they are settled on a future date following the posting date. Upon settlement, the cheque amount is credited to the account's book balance. Increases when cheques are posted in the uncleared format and decreases when such cheques are settled or canceled.

restricted_funds.title: Restricted Funds
restricted_funds.description: Funds temporarily held due to regulatory or operational restrictions, not available for transactions. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

held_funds.title: Held Funds
held_funds.description: Funds temporarily held due to regulatory or operational restrictions, unavailable for transactions, representing the total of earmarked and restricted balances. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

legal_holds.title: Legal holds
legal_holds.description: Total amount of funds currently blocked due to judicial blocks (type = `JUDICIAL`), separate from other balances such as earmarked, restricted funds, or held funds. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

held_checks_balance.title: Held Checks
held_checks_balance.description: Balance for checks that the bank treats as available but keeps on hold to earn interest. It increases when checks are posted as holds and decreases when those checks clear or are canceled. Because balance events are processed asynchronously and their order is not guaranteed, this balance can be temporarily negative until all related events are processed.

remunerative_interest_accrued.title: Remunerative Interest Accrued
remunerative_interest_accrued.description: This balance represents the total interest that is pending capitalization. The amount increases as interest is accrued, and decreases when that interest is added to the principal balance.

change_available_datetime.title: Balance update datetime in ledger
change_available_datetime.description: Datetime when ledger balances were updated in UTC 0. Format = `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssssssssZ`.

division_id.title: Division unique identifier
division_id.description: Unique ID used to identify the division within your organization.

division_code.title: Division code unique identifier
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization.

program_id.title: Program unique identifier
program_id.description: Program ID to which the account belongs within your organization.

tracking_id.title: Tracking unique identifier
tracking_id.description: A unique 50 character long identification for the transaction.

change_available_event_id.title: Change available event identifier
change_available_event_id.description: Unique Available Integrity identifier. this UUID is generated by Ledger.
